name: pnp-sp-dev-teams-sample-msgext-threews-3d-models-ts
title: three.ws 3D models message extension
shortDescription: Teams message extension and link unfurl that shares three.ws 3D models and agents as Adaptive Cards with an interactive stage view.
longDescription: Search and share free three.ws 3D models and public 3D agents from the Teams compose box, or paste a three.ws link and get the same card. The card has a stage view that opens the interactive 3D viewer inside Teams. Built with the Teams AI library (@microsoft/teams.apps) and TypeScript.
